title: Versatile Circuit Board
description: The &6Versatile Circuit Board&r is the final tier of circuit board, requiring &6Bismuth/Arsenic&r and &6Hard Plastic/PVC Bars&r.  As well as this, it is by far the most expensive circuit board, requiring nearly 55 insulators to craft a single one. Used rarely but in small amounts in advanced machines like the &3Fusion Reactor&r and in large amounts in components for the &3ICF Reactor&r.
